Cartoon Game Icons Free Sampler v1.0
by AssetsFactory

140 free cartoon game icons (transparent PNG), taken from our 7 full packs:
simulator, farm and garden, winter and Christmas, fishing, mining, anime fighting, space.

Folders: 512/, 256/, 128/ (pixel sizes). The full packs also have every icon at 1024 px and an atlas.

Files, and the full pack each one comes from:
